title: Khao Yai Vineyard & Foraging Tour
description: Escape to the cooler climate of the Khao Yai wine region to forage for wild mushrooms and bamboo shoots before enjoying a premium Thai wine tasting.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The Khao Yai Vineyard & Foraging Tour is a 5-hour, nature-focused experience in [Thailand](/destinations/thailand/)'s "New Latitude" wine region, involving foraging near Khao Yai National Park and a bespoke lunch at GranMonte or PB Valley estates. This culinary offering pairs foraged ingredients with award-winning local Syrahs and Chenin Blancs.
> 
> *   The tour operates year-round, requires advance booking, and includes luxury SUV transfers, with a moderate physical demand due to forest walking. AGS provides priority reservations and skip-the-line access, enhancing the sophisticated and relaxing atmosphere.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Escape to the cooler climate of the Khao Yai wine region to forage for wild mushrooms and bamboo shoots before enjoying a premium Thai wine tasting.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Khao Yai has emerged as a serious 'New Latitude' wine-producing region. Surrounding the national park, specialized culinary tours are fusing indigenous forest foraging with sophisticated vineyard operations.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
In the morning, join a local expert guide to walk the fringes of Khao Yai National Park, learning to identify and forage edible wild herbs, mushrooms, and bamboo. 

You then transfer to the GranMonte or PB Valley estate. The foraged ingredients are handed over to the estate chef who prepares a bespoke lunch, which is expertly paired with award-winning local Syrahs and Chenin Blancs.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Nature-focused, Sophisticated, Relaxing |
| **Duration** | 5 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | Moderate (Forest walking) |
| **Best Paired With** | A trip extending from Bangkok to the cooler mountains. |

## Pairing Khao Yai’s Cool Highland Vineyards With InterContinental Khao Yai & Northern Bangkok Golf
Rising 350 to 800 meters above sea level on the southwestern rim of the UNESCO-listed Khao Yai National Park—just 2 to 2.5 hours northeast of Bangkok via the new M6 elevated motorway—**Khao Yai** is Thailand’s premier mountain retreat and "New Latitude" wine country. For golfers escaping the humidity of the Chao Phraya basin, Khao Yai offers crisp 18°C–24°C morning mountain air and Bill Bensley’s whimsical upcycled heritage train suites at [InterContinental Khao Yai Resort](/accommodations/thailand/intercontinental-khao-yai/).

On a customized Bangkok & Highlands itinerary, groups pair rounds on Bangkok’s northern championship corridor—including Ron Garl’s [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/), the 36 holes of [Cascata Golf Club](/courses/thailand/cascata/), and newly renovated [Flora Ville Golf & Country Club](/courses/thailand/flora-ville/)—with two nights at [InterContinental Khao Yai Resort](/accommodations/thailand/intercontinental-khao-yai/) to explore the Asoke Valley vineyards.

## Forest Foraging, GranMonte Estate Tasting & Winemaker’s Lunch
* **Guided National Park Buffer Foraging:** Walk the shaded trails bordering Khao Yai National Park with a local ethnobotanist to identify wild galangal shoots, forest mushrooms, indigenous ant-egg delicacies, and sweet bamboo tips before the midday sun warms the valley.
* **Private Chenin Blanc & Syrah Barrel Tasting at GranMonte or PB Valley:** Step into the temperature-controlled cellar at *GranMonte Vineyard and Winery* (run by oenologist Nikki Lohitnavy) to sample award-winning Khao Yai Viognier, Verdelho, and Syrah grown in calcareous clay soils, followed by a private vineyard veranda lunch incorporating your morning harvest.

## Connecting Khao Yai’s Wine Country With Bangkok’s Northern Fairways
For travelers combining a stay at [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) with two nights in the cool mountain air of [InterContinental Khao Yai Resort](/accommodations/thailand/intercontinental-khao-yai/), we recommend playing a morning championship round at [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/), [Cascata Golf Club](/courses/thailand/cascata/), or [Flora Ville Golf & Country Club](/courses/thailand/flora-ville/) on your way north from Bangkok, arriving in Khao Yai in time for sunset cocktails and waking up refreshed for your morning forest foraging walk and GranMonte estate wine pairing.

faqs.q: How far is the Khao Yai wine region from Bangkok and InterContinental Khao Yai Resort?
faqs.a: Khao Yai's Asoke Valley vineyards (GranMonte and PB Valley) sit just 15 to 20 minutes from InterContinental Khao Yai Resort and approximately 2 hours northeast of Bangkok via the expressway.

faqs.q: Which golf courses pair best with a Khao Yai vineyard and foraging escape?
faqs.a: Golfers typically play Alpine Golf Club, Cascata Golf Club, or Bangkok Golf Club on the northern side of Bangkok en route to Khao Yai, alongside scenic mountain golf rounds in the Khao Yai valley.

faqs.q: When is the grape harvest season at Khao Yai's vineyards in Thailand?
faqs.a: Unlike European vineyards, Khao Yai's tropical highland grape harvest takes place during the cool dry winter months of January and February—coinciding directly with Thailand's peak golf season.
